title: Delicate Poke Bowl with German Dates
description: A light and refreshing Poke bowl featuring delicate fish, topped with sweet German dates and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: 1. Cut the delicate fish into small pieces and place in a bowl.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together Poke seasoning, coconut oil, and sesame oil.
3. Pour the seasoning mixture over the fish and toss to coat.
4. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
5. Just before serving, toast the sesame seeds in a dry pan over medium heat.
6. Slice the German dates into thin wedges.
7. Arrange the mixed greens on a plate or bowl.
8. Top the greens with the marinated fish, German dates, chopped cucumber, and sliced green onions.
9. Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over the top.
